#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n;
    std::cin >> n;
    std::string st;
    std::cin >> st;

    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    std::vector<std::string> inner_parts;
    int max_length = 0;
    int inner_count = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < st.size(); ) {
        if (st[i] == '(') {
            std::string inner_str;
            i++; // skip '('
            while (i < st.size() && st[i] != ')') {
                inner_str += st[i];
                i++;
            }
            // skip ')'
            i++;
            inner_parts.push_back(inner_str);
        } else {
            std::string ch(1, st[i]);
            parts.push_back(ch);
            i++;
        }
    }

    // Find maximum length among parts
    for (const auto& s : parts) {
        max_length = std::max(max_length, (int)s.length());
    }

    // Count non-empty inner parts
    for (const auto& s : inner_parts) {
        if (!s.empty()) {
            inner_count++;
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_length << " " << inner_count << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
